title: enhanced-canary-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Ravi Krishnan
description:
Summary: Adds an enhanced canary + shadow + A/B autorollback workflow and safety guards. Motivation: customers running mixed workloads reported intermittent regressions after model rollouts where noisy metrics from shadow traffic caused false positives or delayed rollbacks. This change unifies the rollout controller and autorollback engine to: 1) support shadow-probing windows with metric quorum and weighted voting, 2) add multi-stage canary ramps that include both production and shadow probes, 3) introduce adaptive thresholding and cooldowns to reduce flapping, and 4) surface richer observability for post-mortem and alerting.

Linked work: ENG-4123 (autorollback refactor), ENG-4190 (shadow probing telemetry). Related: SUP-2381 customer incident and follow-up action items.

What I changed (high-level):
- rollout/controller.go: merge staging and autorollback state machines to share the probing engine and simplify life-cycle transitions.
- rollout/autorollback/engine.go: new adaptive quorum logic, multi-metric aggregator, and cooldown timer.
- workflows/canary-shadow-autorollback.yaml: new declarative workflow providing canary weight ramps, shadow probing windows and A/B split options.
- telemetry/metrics.go: added rollout.probing.* metrics, rollout.quorum.vote and rollout.cooldown.* metrics.
- observability/dashboards/rollout.json: dashboard tiles for quorum votes, metric drift, and canary health.
- tests/e2e/rollouts_test.go: added deterministic e2e tests that simulate noisy shadow traffic and verify stability guards.
- docs/deployments/rollouts.md: documented new workflow options and recommended defaults.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for quorum voting and adaptive thresholds
- [x] Integration tests for controller state transitions
- [x] E2E tests simulating shadow noise and verifying autorollback behavior
- [x] Telemetry and dashboard updates
- [x] Updated docs and examples

Notes on behaviour and defaults:
- The quorum requires at least 3 independent metrics (latency, error_rate, quality_score) with a minimum sample quorum over probing window. Voting is weighted by signal reliability and can be tuned per-customer.
- Shadow traffic is treated as probing-only by default (no user-impacting rollouts) and has a separate bias parameter that reduces its influence on immediate rollbacks unless quorum strongly indicates regression.
- Cooldown windows prevent immediate re-attempts for a configurable period after rollback. Default cooldown = 10m.

Why this is safe: The controller defaults are conservative; new behavior is behind workflow configuration and feature flag rollout.controller.enhanced_quorum. Existing rollouts continue to use legacy behavior until the flag is flipped and existing blue/green and simple canary workflows remain supported.

Migration and rollout plan:
1) Merge this PR behind the feature flag.
2) Run canary deployments of the controller in staging and canary clusters for 48h with synthetic traffic.
3) Enable the workflow in a small subset of internal customers, monitor rollout.quorum.vote and rollout.cooldown.* metrics.
4) Gradually flip defaults after 2 weeks of monitoring and no regressions.

Release notes:
- Enhanced canary + shadow probing autorollback workflow with adaptive quorum and cooldowns; improved telemetry and e2e coverage.

Backwards compatibility: No breaking changes to existing workflow specs. New fields are additive.

review_comments: Asha Patel: Can we ensure the quorum window size is configurable per-workflow? I don't want 60s hardcoded anywhere.
Author (Ravi): Yes — moved to workflow spec with a default of 60s and validations in engine.go. Added unit test for custom window size.
Liam Chen: The cooldown default of 10m seems long for internal canaries. Suggest making the default per-environment and lowering for internal testing.
Author (Ravi): Updated to support environment overrides; docs updated with recommendation for internal test environments.
Marisol Gomez: Observability tiles look good. Please add an alerting example for quorum failures so SREs can act quickly.
Author (Ravi): Added example alert rules and linked them in docs.
Evan Brooks: e2e flakes observed on first run; looks like a race in controller shutdown. Please fix and re-run CI.
Author (Ravi): Fixed shutdown race by adding a context cancellation guard in controller.go; re-ran e2e successfully.
